paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The plot illustrates accuracy with respect to s_pop frequency. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" and features a linear scale with plotted values ranging from 1 to 19, displaying numeric tick labels regularly spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. Two data series are represented on the graph, both incorporating vertical error bars. The first series is shown as a blue dashed line with circular markers, beginning with an accuracy of approximately 0.70 at x=1. It rises to roughly 0.97 at x=5, dips slightly to 0.95 at x=7, and reaches 1.0 at x=9 and x=11. The line then declines to about 0.90 at x=13 before returning to a steady value of 1.0 from x=15 through the final data point at x=19. The second series is depicted as a green solid line with square markers, starting at an initial value of approximately 0.36 at x=1. This line rises to about 0.68 at x=7, drops to roughly 0.45 at x=9, and increases to approximately 0.66 at x=11. It subsequently declines to about 0.60 at x=13 and 0.50 at x=15, before rising sharply to reach a value of 1.0 at x=17, which it maintains at the end of the plotted range at x=19.
